Main.Tray.Hint: Tick the icons to hide. Hidden programs keep running in the background; they just disappear from the tray and the overflow panel.
Main.Window.Hint: Tick the windows to hide. Hiding a window does not end its program; it leaves one of our own icons in the tray, click it to restore.
Main.Tooltip.TrayRow: Click to tick, double-click to hide / show immediately
Main.Tooltip.WindowRow: Click to tick, double-click to hide / restore immediately
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.AutoStart.Title: Start with Windows
Settings.AutoStart.Description: Run in the background after signing in, restoring the last hidden state.
Settings.HideSelfTray.Title: Hide this app's tray icon
Settings.MinimizeToTray.Title: Minimize to tray when closing the window
Settings.MinimizeToTray.Description: The hide guard keeps running after you close the window, so hidden icons don't come back.
Settings.HideAppTrayWithWindow.Title: Also hide the program's tray icon when hiding its window
Settings.HideAppTrayWithWindow.Descripti: When a window goes to the tray, hide that program's own tray icon too; restore it together with the window.
Settings.RestoreWindowsOnExit.Title: Restore hidden windows when this app exits
Settings.RestoreWindowsOnExit.Descriptio: Closing this app brings the windows back to the desktop instead of leaving them hidden.
Settings.Hotkeys.WinCheckTip: Windows consumes Win combinations before the app sees them. To record something like Ctrl + Win + T, tick this box first, then press Ctrl + T.
Settings.Hotkeys.ResetTip: Restore just the 5 global shortcuts to their defaults; hidden records and other switches stay unchanged.
Settings.Hotkeys.Hint: Click Edit, then press the combination. Delete clears the row, Esc cancels. Tick Add Win when Win must take part. A failed registration keeps the old shortcut and reports the conflict.
Settings.RestoreAll.Title: Restore all hidden icons
Settings.RestoreAll.Description: Clear the hidden records. Icons come back to the tray once their programs register again.
Settings.Repair.Title: Repair icons with a broken right-click menu
Settings.Repair.Description: Retries icons left by older versions; if an icon is already an unresponsive substitute, restart that program instead.
Settings.ConfigPath.Title: Config file location
Settings.Exit.Title: Exit the app
Settings.Exit.Description: Nothing will be hidden after exiting, and hidden windows are restored.
Settings.Language.Title: Language
Settings.Language.Description: Switch the interface language. Takes effect immediately and is saved.
Settings.RunOnce.Title: Exit after hiding (don't stay resident)
Settings.RunOnce.Description: After "Start with Windows" is enabled, turning this on makes TrayHider apply the hidden state at logon and then exit by itself.
Hotkey.ShowMain.Title: Show main window
Hotkey.ShowMain.Description: Shows the main window even when this app's tray icon is hidden.
Hotkey.ToggleHideWindow.Title: Hide / restore current window
Hotkey.ToggleHideWindow.Description: Sends the foreground window to the tray; press again to bring it back.
Hotkey.HideAllWindows.Title: Hide all windows
Hotkey.HideAllWindows.Description: Sends every hideable window to the tray; the programs keep running.
Hotkey.RestoreAllWindows.Title: Show all windows
Hotkey.RestoreAllWindows.Description: Restores every window that was sent to the tray.
Hotkey.ToggleTrayIcons.Title: Hide / restore all tray icons
Hotkey.ToggleTrayIcons.Description: Hides all tray icons when some are visible, restores them when all are hidden.
Hotkey.Clear.Tip: Clear the shortcut for "{0}" (other actions unaffected)
Main.Status.MinimizedToTray: Minimized to tray; the hide guard keeps running
Main.Confirm.HideAllTray.Title: Confirm hide all
Main.Confirm.HideAllWindows.Title: Confirm hide all
Main.Confirm.HideAllWindows.Text:
Hide all windows to the tray?
The programs keep running; use the shortcut or the tray icon to restore them.
Settings.Permission.ElevatedHint: Running as administrator: programs that run elevated can be managed too (their tray icons and windows included). A broken right-click menu is not always about privileges — programs with their own substitute icon, or programs that ignore the shell's tray rebuild, must be restarted to recover.
Settings.Permission.NormalHint: Running with normal privileges. Some programs that run elevated (security tools, driver services) can only be restored or hidden after elevation; use the button on the right when needed. A broken right-click menu is not necessarily about privileges: restarting the program recovers the ones that ignore the tray rebuild.
Settings.Permission.AlreadyElevated: Already running as administrator, no need to relaunch.
Settings.Permission.RelaunchConfirm:
TrayHider will restart as administrator.

Currently hidden tray icons stay hidden (config unchanged), hidden windows are restored while exiting, and you can take them over again with “Restore all hidden icons” after the restart.

Continue?
Settings.Permission.RelaunchFailed: Elevation was cancelled or failed; the app keeps running with normal privileges.
Settings.Exit.ConfirmText:
Quit TrayHider?

Hidden icons come back once their programs register again, hidden windows are restored, and the hide guard stops.
Hotkey.Error.NoKey: No main key detected; press a letter, digit or function key as well.
Hotkey.Error.NoModifier: A shortcut needs at least one modifier (Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Win). Tick “Add Win” below first when Win must take part.
Hotkey.Error.ModifierOnly: Only a modifier was pressed; press a letter, digit or function key as well.
Hotkey.Error.SystemReserved: Windows reserves this combination (for example Win + L / Win + D / Win + E / Win + Tab), so it cannot be taken over. Please pick another one.
Hotkey.Register.Failed: This combination could not be registered: another program may use it, or it duplicates another action. The previous shortcut is kept; please pick another one.
Hotkey.Clear.Failed: Could not clear the shortcut. Please try again.
Hotkey.Reset.Success: All 5 global shortcuts were restored to their defaults; other settings are unchanged.
Hotkey.Reset.Note:
All 5 global shortcuts were restored to their defaults; other settings are unchanged.

Settings.RunOncePolling.Title: Periodic polling
Settings.RunOncePolling.Description: When on, a scheduled task re-applies the hidden state every 10 minutes (more reliable, but wakes the process periodically). When off, the state is applied once at logon and TrayHider exits silently as soon as every tracked icon is hidden.
